title: No Lyrics. No Lyrics. Instrumental.
author: gravesisme
selftext:
I’ve been working on an iOS game called Hurricane Harrison for the past 6 months and have been using Suno to generate the music. I’ve been really pleased with the results overall, but since each run lasts 5–6 minutes, I need fairly long songs, and occasionally Suno decides to ignore the instrumental flag and add vocals anyway.

I couldn’t stop laughing when I heard this one.

I hope I’m not alone in finding little AI-generated gems like this that you absolutely can’t ship, but somehow make your day anyway.
